Why is infinite yield lagging if you execute it? 
An "Infinite Yield" warning in Roblox (and similar game engines) indicates a potential for your script to enter a loop that never finishes, potentially leading to lag and freezes. This usually happens when a script is waiting for an event or resource that never arrives, effectively blocking the script from proceeding and causing the engine to wait indefinitely. 
Here's a breakdown of why this causes lag:
Blocking Execution:
When a script yields, it effectively stops executing until the condition it's waiting for is met. An infinite yield means the script is indefinitely stuck in this waiting state. 
Resource Consumption:
While waiting, the script can still consume system resources (CPU, memory) without doing any useful work. This can lead to a gradual slowdown in the overall game. 
Engine Response:
The game engine, in this case Roblox, might attempt to resolve the infinite yield by waiting for a timeout or other mechanism, further delaying execution and potentially causing the engine to become unresponsive. 
Example:
A common cause is using :WaitForChild() on a non-existent object. If the object never appears, the script will yield forever, causing the infinite yield warning. 
In essence, the "Infinite Yield" warning is a flag that your script is potentially stuck in a loop, leading to a slowdown and potentially a freeze due to the engine's inability to make progress.

scripts.script:
local Material = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kinlei/MaterialLua/master/Module.lua"))()
local Settings = {}

local UI = Material.Load({
     Title = "Kronos",
     Style = 1,
     SizeX = 400,
     SizeY = 250,
     Theme = "Dark"
})

local main = UI.New({Title = "Main"})
local mob_list = {}
for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do 
    if v:IsA("Model") and v:FindFirstChild("NPC") and not table.find(mob_list, v.Name) then 
        table.insert(mob_list, v.Name)
    end
end

main.Dropdown({
    Text = "Select NPC",
    Options = mob_list,
    Callback = function(v)
        Settings["ChosenMob"] = v 
    end
})

main.Toggle({
    Text = "Autofarm",
    Enabled = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        Settings["Autofarm"] = v 
    end
})

spawn(function()
    while wait() do 
        if Settings.Autofarm then 
            pcall(function()
                if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Combat") then 
                    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:EquipTool(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Combat")) 
                end
                
                for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                    if v:IsA("Model") and v.Name == Settings.ChosenMob then 
                        repeat wait() 
                            game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart").CFrame * CFrame.new(0,0,4)
                            workspace[game.Players.LocalPlayer.Name]:FindFirstChild("Combat").Attack.A1:FireServer(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer)
                        until not Settings.Autofarm or v:FindFirstChild("Humanoid").Health <= 0
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)

scripts.script:
function countButtons()
	local n = 0
	for i, v in pairs(getPlayerTycoon()["P1 Stuff"].Buttons:GetChildren()) do
		if v:FindFirstChild("Head") and not v:FindFirstChild("GamePass") then
			n = n+1
		end
	end
	return n
end

function getPlayerTycoon()
	local Tycoon = "None"
	for i, v in pairs(game:GetService("Workspace")["Legend's 2P Tycoon Kit"].Tycoons:GetChildren()) do
		if v:FindFirstChild("P1 Stuff") and v["P1 Stuff"]:FindFirstChild("P1") and v["P1 Stuff"].P1.Value == game.Players.LocalPlayer.Name then
			Tycoon = v
		end
	end
	return Tycoon
end

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Events.CrateClaim:FireServer("Cash", 1e+16)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if countButtons() <= 0 then break end
		task.wait()
		for i, v in pairs(getPlayerTycoon()["P1 Stuff"].Buttons:GetChildren()) do
			if v:FindFirstChild("Head") and not v:FindFirstChild("GamePass") then
				firetouchinterest(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Torso, v.Head, 0)
			end
			if v.Name == " " then
				v:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
end)
